title: kehte the sab peet ke sar haaye haaye
body:
kehte the sab peet ke sar haaye haaye
abide bekas ke pisar haaye haaye
laqte dile hazrate qairunnisa
jafare sadiq ke pidar haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
shiyo ka is gham se hai dil chaak chaak
shaad hai sab baanie shar haaye haaye
hogayi hai shamme imaamat qamosh
sam ne kiya apna asar haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
nazro me hai jafare sadiq ke aaj
*mehdi* jaha'n zero zabar haaye haaye
